column1: **ccellpert_nts:** Number of time steps after which perturbations are seeded
**ccellpert_sw2b:** Only south and west bnds perturbed (for idealized cases): 0=off; 1=south & west; 2=south *C-M if cellpertSelector > 0*
**ccellpert_amp:** Maximum amplitude for the potential temperature perturbations *C-M if cellpertSelector > 0*
**ccellpert_gppc:** Number of grid points conforming the cell *C-M if cellpertSelector > 0*
**ccellpert_ndbc:** Number of cells normal to domain lateral boundaries *C-M if cellpertSelector > 0*
**ccellpert_kbottom:** Z-grid point where the perturbations start *C-M if cellpertSelector > 0*
**ccellpert_ktop:** Z-grid point where the perturbations end *C-M if cellpertSelector > 0*
**ccellpert_tvcp:** Time-varying CP method selector: 0=off; 1=on (hydroBCs==1) *C-M if cellpertSelector > 0*
**ccellpert_eckert:** Eckert number for the potential temperature perturbations (hydroBCs==1) *C-M if cellpertSelector > 0*
**ccellpert_tsfact:** Factor on the refreshing perturbation time scale (hydroBCs==1) *C-M if cellpertSelector > 0*
